newsitem.title: JAPAN: Jusco names Motoya Okada new president.
newsitem.headline: Jusco names Motoya Okada new president.

text.p: Japanese supermarket chain operator Jusco Co Ltd said on Thursday it had named senior managing director Motoya Okada its new president.
Okada's predecessor, Kenji Tanaka, was arrested on Tuesday in connection with an illicit loans scandal involving Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd, where Tanaka was once a senior managing director.
A Jusco spokesman said Tanaka's arrest was related to a period in which he was employed by Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank and that Jusco as a company was not involved in the scandal.
The spokesman quoted Takuya Okada, Motoya Okada's father and chairman of the company, as saying that Jusco would nevertheless continue to do business with Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank as before.
